# How to Ask the Other Family for Documents

Ask early, ask both ways, and keep it warm. Most families say yes when the request is mutual.

## When should you ask?

Before the roka is a good time. Feelings are still light then, and nobody has spent money on the wedding. If you wait until after the engagement, the same question can feel like an accusation, and that is much harder for everyone.

## What should you say?

Keep it short. Say that your family will share the same papers, and that you ask every family this. Then stop talking and let them answer.

If someone asks for money, report it on the [National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal](https://cybercrime.gov.in/) or call 1930.

Read the [parents guide](/for-parents), the piece on [red flags](/matrimonial-fraud/red-flags) and our note on [documents](/documents-and-records/which-documents).
